answer: Beacon-assigned audit tasks. After registration, a public verifiable-randomness beacon assigns each identity a random audit thread and task seed it cannot predict. Enrollment consumes one non-refundable compute credit; failure to return a valid proof by deadline revokes the identity. Because the pool is not a fixed garden, Sybils cannot pre-solve challenges. Verifying a shale sample is one possible draw, so each fake identity still needs a live worker and paid compute credit per epoch.
